# American Speech-Language-Hearing Association (ASHA)

> ASHA is the professional organization for audiologists and speech-language pathologists, offering certification, continuing education, career resources, and advocacy for communication sciences and disorders.

ASHA serves over 200,000 members in audiology and speech-language pathology professions. The organization provides certification standards (CCC-A, CCC-SLP, C-AA, C-SLPA), continuing education through its CE Registry, annual conventions, research resources, and professional advocacy at state and federal levels.

## Key Topics

- Speech-Language Pathology (SLP)
- Audiology
- ASHA Certification (CCC-A, CCC-SLP)
- Continuing Education (CEUs)
- Professional Membership
- ASHA Convention
- Practice Management
- Career Resources
- Research and Evidence Maps
- Advocacy and Licensing
- Academic Programs
- Assistant Certification (C-AA, C-SLPA)
- Reimbursement and Billing
- Professional Development

## Membership & Certification

- [About the American Speech-Language-Hearing Association (ASHA)](https://www.asha.org/about): ASHA organization overview defining mission, membership, and professional standards.
- [Join ASHA](https://www.asha.org/members/join-asha): Membership information for audiologists, SLPs, and certification pathways.
- [Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology Certification](https://www.asha.org/certification): ASHA certification standards (CCC-A, CCC-SLP) and professional credentials.
- [ASHA Assistants Program](https://www.asha.org/assistants-certification-program): Certification for audiology and SLP assistants (C-AA, C-SLPA).

## Professional Development & Continuing Education

- [ASHA Continuing Education](https://www.asha.org/ce): CE Registry with thousands of courses and CEU tracking for professionals.
- [Conferences and Events](https://www.asha.org/events): ASHA Convention and professional conferences for continuing education.
- [Publications of the American Speech-Language-Hearing Association (ASHA)](https://www.asha.org/publications): ASHA journals, newsmagazine, podcasts, and research publications.
- [Home - ASHA Stream](https://stream.asha.org/home): Video content featuring ASHA member profiles and professional career stories.

## Career Resources & Job Search

- [Speech-Language Pathology (SLP) Jobs, Audiology Jobs, and Career Information](https://www.asha.org/careers): Career portal for SLP and audiology job search, salary data, and recruitment.
- [Information for Students Interested in Communication Sciences and Disorders](https://www.asha.org/students): Student resources for audiology and SLP career planning and education.

## Professional Practice & Resources

- [Information for Audiologists](https://www.asha.org/aud): Audiology-specific resources, practice management, and professional programs.
- [Information for Speech-Language Pathologists (SLPs)](https://www.asha.org/slp): SLP-specific resources, certification standards, and practice guidance.
- [Practice Management for Audiologists and Speech-Language Pathologists](https://www.asha.org/practice): Practice management guidance on billing, reimbursement, ethics, and coding.
- [Research in Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology](https://www.asha.org/research): Research resources, grants, Evidence Maps, and outcome measurement systems.

## Academic & Advocacy

- [Information for Academic Programs & Faculty](https://www.asha.org/academic): Academic program resources, faculty mentoring, and CSD education data.
- [Advocacy](https://www.asha.org/advocacy): ASHA state and federal advocacy, policy positions, and licensing regulations.

## Member Portal

- [American Speech-Language-Hearing Association | ASHA](https://www.asha.org): ASHA homepage with organization overview and main member resources.
- [Login to ASHA.org](https://apps.asha.org/eweb/olsdynamicpage.aspx): Member portal login and account access for ASHA professionals.
- [Login to ASHA.org](https://apps.asha.org/eweb/startpage.aspx): Member portal entry point for ASHA professionals.
- [American Speech-Language-Hearing Association | ASHA](https://apps.asha.org/eweb/ashalogin.aspx): Professional login portal for ASHA members and continuing education access.
